limits: HTTP transport only, not a model A/B or native direct CLI measurement. Strong native direct model attempt failed authentication; see model-ledger.json.
Unconditional full read is the prior web policy when explicitly refreshed; this benchmark scripts equal request counts, not human refresh behavior.
Auto monitoring adds idle requests compared with a user who does not refresh. A direct CLI can stream its own result without these polling requests.
Body bytes and reconstructed response header bytes are separate; request base headers, TCP/IP framing and browser rendering are excluded. Conditional header overhead is included separately.
No human active time, tokens, billing, semantic quality or 8-hour runtime measured; modelCalls=0 does not make development free.
Latency samples cover short local requests only. No P95, statistical significance or remote latency claim.
